question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Writing books about how to ______ on the internet seems like a great idea.
solution:
The correct answer is 'make a fortune.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let us see the meanings of the given options:
 
 
• **Make a promise:**

 
 
• The meaning of the idiom** "make a promise" **is to tell someone that one will definitely do something in the future: to promise.
 
• Idiom "make a promise" का अर्थ है वादा करना।
 
 
• **Example:** *He **made a promise**__ to help her.*
 
 
 
 
 
• **Make a fortune:**
 __
 
• The meaning of the idiom **"make a fortune" **is to earn a very large amount of money, especially by doing something very successfully.
 
• Idiom "make a fortune" का अर्थ बहुत बड़ी मात्रा में धन अर्जित करना है, विशेष रूप से किसी कार्य को बहुत सफलतापूर्वक करके। 
 
 
• **Example:** *We'll **make a fortune**__ if we can manage to secure a trading partner in China.*
 
 
 
 
 
• *​​***Make a habit: **
 __
 
• The meaning of the idiom **"make a habit"** is to begin to do something regularly, often without thinking about it.
 
• Idiom "make a habit" का अर्थ नियमित रूप से कुछ करना शुरू करना है, अक्सर इसके बारे में सोचे बिना।
 
 
• **Example:** *He **made a habit**__ of ignoring me whenever his friends were around.*
 
 
 
 
 
• **Make a list:**
 __
 
• To** "make a list"** is to put things in order or to name them, like a grocery list or a wish list.
 
• "Make a list" का अर्थ चीजों को व्यवस्थित करना या उन्हें नाम देना है, जैसे किराने की सूची या इच्छा सूची।
 
 
 
 
 
• Now, this sentence refers to writing a book on a topic which seems to be a great idea. 
 
• So, the most appropriate answer in this context is **"make a fortune."**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 ​

Correct sentence: *Writing books about how to **make a fortune**__ on the internet seems like a great idea.*
